## Finish with positive indices {#positive}

Work with one letter at a time. Write a factor with a negative index as a reciprocal.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$\dfrac{(3x^2y)^2}{6xy^3}$

::: {.fragment}

[Square each factor.]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{9x^4y^2}{6xy^3}$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Subtract the indices for each letter.]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{3}{2}x^{4-1}y^{2-3}$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Rewrite the negative power.]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{3}{2}x^3y^{-1}=\dfrac{3x^3}{2y}$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$\dfrac{(2ab^3)^2}{8a^3b}$

Try it on paper, then select **Next** to check.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{4a^2b^6}{8a^3b}=\dfrac{1}{2}a^{-1}b^5$

$=\dfrac{b^5}{2a}$

:::
